name: msb_high_is_a_normal_value_when_the_range_is_a_power_of_two
citation: MISB ST 1201.3 §7.2.3, Table 1 row 2: '1 0 0 Normal mapped value but this is the max value of the normal mapping values; this is the only normal value that has the MSB=1'
note: THE FIXTURE THAT SEPARATES A CONJUNCTION FROM AN MSB TEST. A decoder testing only the MSB reads this as a signal and loses the top of every power-of-two range. It arises only when (b-a) is a power of two, which is why the range here is 256 and not one of the fourteen items'.
